releaseNotes: v0.1.1 (beta): Tested on an H2D. Setup needs only the IP and access code: the serial is read from the printer. Sampling instead of streaming: printing printers are checked every 30 seconds and idle ones every 5 minutes, instead of a full status every second. Heater status (Heating, At temp, Cooling, Off) with targets, temperatures only at temperature in 5 degree steps, elapsed time, times in 5 minute steps. Pause, Resume, Stop and speed are one Printer Control command. Printers are recreated once on update (now keyed by slot), so recheck rules that use them. Main page banner matches Hubitat's built-in apps (gopher.ny).
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Bambu Lab Integration
apps.description: Adds your Bambu Lab printers by IP, serial and access code, sets each one to Monitor only or Monitor and control, and lets you choose which devices Hubitat creates.

drivers.name: Bambu Lab Printer
drivers.description: One per printer: the local MQTT connection, print status, temperatures, errors and tile, plus print control in control mode. Created by the app.

drivers.name: Bambu Lab AMS
drivers.description: One per AMS unit: humidity, temperature, and filament type, color and amount for each tray.
